mechanisms.name: A-MEM note construction + LLM link generation (Zettelkasten)
mechanisms.exact_spec: Note m_i = {c_i, t_i, K_i, G_i, X_i, e_i, L_i} (content, timestamp, keywords, tags, context, embedding, links). K_i,G_i,X_i <- LLM(c_i || t_i || Ps1). e_i = f_enc[concat(c_i, K_i, G_i, X_i)] (all-MiniLM-L6-v2). Link candidates: cosine s_n,j, M_near = top-k (paper default k=10; Table 8 uses 10-50 per task/model). L_i <- LLM(m_n || M_near || Ps2). Code analyze_content prompt asks for JSON {keywords (most->least important), context, tags}. Query time: plain cosine top-k; code search_agentic then appends linked notes flagged is_neighbor=True but returns memories[:k]. Paper-reported: ~1,200 tokens per memory op, 5.4 s latency (GPT-4o-mini); LoCoMo GPT-4o-mini F1 multi-hop 27.02, temporal 45.85, single-hop 44.65.
mechanisms.adopt_for_memory_hub: ADOPT as nightly 'dream linker' (claude -p, MEMORY_HUB_INTERNAL=1). For each chunk/fact created since last run: candidates = top-10 by existing halfvec HNSW, excluding same session_id. Prompt: new memory (id, ts, project, ctx_header, text) + 10 candidates (id, ts, project, 300-char snippet) -> JSON only {links:[{to, relation: same_topic|continues|example_of|contradicts|supersedes, confidence 0..1, why <=20 words}], keywords[], tags[]}. Validate with zod, DROP any 'to' id not in the candidate list (hallucinated ids). Insert synapses kind=dream, w=confidence*0.8, why, source_uuids. keywords/tags go to a derived node_meta table, never into chunks/turns. relation contradicts/supersedes touching a rule/feedback chunk -> review_queue, not an edge.
mechanisms.cost: Paper-reported ~1.2k tokens/op; for memory-hub estimate ~3-4k input tokens per new chunk (11 snippets), batchable 5 chunks/call. Not measured.

mechanisms.name: A-MEM memory evolution (strengthen / update_neighbor)
mechanisms.exact_spec: For each neighbor m_j in M_near: m_j* <- LLM(m_n || M_near \ m_j || m_j || Ps3); m_j* REPLACES m_j. Code prompt (verbatim excerpt): 'Should this memory be evolved?... What specific actions should be taken (strengthen, update_neighbor)?' JSON {should_evolve, actions, suggested_connections, tags_to_update, new_context_neighborhood, new_tags_neighborhood}. strengthen -> note.links.extend(suggested_connections), note.tags = new tags; update_neighbor -> overwrite neighbors' context+tags in place. consolidate_memories() every evo_threshold=100 adds.
mechanisms.adopt_for_memory_hub: PARTIAL. 'strengthen' = add dream synapse (above). 'update_neighbor' only on derived node_meta rows with a version column (old row kept), never on raw chunks, Obsidian notes, or ลุงจืด's rules/feedback; anything that would change a rule's meaning -> review_queue. Skip consolidate every-100 (nightly batch already covers it).
mechanisms.cost: One extra LLM call per new memory if run separately; fold into the dream-linker call (same prompt returns links + neighbor tag updates) to avoid doubling.

mechanisms.name: HippoRAG v1 Personalized PageRank with node specificity
mechanisms.exact_spec: Offline: 1-shot NER then OpenIE triples -> KG nodes (noun phrases); synonymy edges when retriever cosine > tau = 0.8; P = |N|x|P| count matrix of phrase-in-passage. Online: query NER -> each entity mapped to argmax-cosine KG node; personalization = equal probability on query nodes, 0 elsewhere, each multiplied by node specificity s_i = |P_i|^-1 (P_i = passages containing node i). PPR damping 0.5. Passage score pi_p = pi'_n * P. Paper-reported R@2/R@5: MuSiQue 40.9/51.9, 2Wiki 70.7/89.1, HotpotQA 60.5/77.7; ablation w/o node specificity MuSiQue 37.6/50.2; query nodes only without PPR 37.1/41.0; online retrieval 10-30x cheaper and 6-13x faster than IRCoT.
mechanisms.adopt_for_memory_hub: ADOPT node specificity idea = fan normalization (it is IDF on graph nodes; memory-hub already has term_df). Use row-normalized weights wn = w/sum(w out of src) so hub chunks (CLAUDE.md boilerplate, 'ok' turns) cannot flood activation. Full-graph PPR NOT adopted for the hot path (see latency pitfall); truncated PPR over a 2-hop ball is an optional reranker measured at 11.9 ms p95 locally.
mechanisms.cost: Offline OpenIE per passage is the expensive part (LLM); memory-hub can skip OpenIE because chunks are the nodes and edges come from kNN/temporal/wikilink/usage/dream.

mechanisms.name: HippoRAG 2 dense-sparse graph + seeding (official code defaults)
mechanisms.exact_spec: Graph: phrase nodes + passage nodes; passage->phrase 'contains' edges weight 1.0 (code: node_to_node_stats[passage_edge] = 1.0); fact edges weight = co-occurrence count (+1 per triple); synonymy edges weight = cosine score, threshold synonymy_edge_sim_threshold=0.8, max 100 per node, KNN synonymy_edge_topk=2047. Query-to-triple matching via embeddings, then LLM triple filter (DSPy MIPROv2-tuned prompt, Appendix A; not quoted here). Seeds: phrase weight = fact_score / len(ent_node_to_chunk_ids[phrase]) averaged over occurrences, keep linking_top_k=5 phrases; ALL passages seeded with min_max_normalize(dense score) * passage_node_weight (0.05). run_ppr: graph.personalized_pagerank(damping=0.5, directed=False, weights='weight', reset=reset_prob, implementation='prpack'); rank passages by PPR score. Defaults: retrieval_top_k=200, qa_top_k=5, embedder NV-Embed-v2. Paper-reported: Recall@5 avg 87.1 full; w/o filter 86.4; w/o passage node 81.0; NER-to-node 74.6; QA 1.2 s/query; MuSiQue indexing 99.5 min for 11,656 passages.
mechanisms.adopt_for_memory_hub: ADOPT the shape: chunks = passage nodes, future dream-extracted facts = phrase-like nodes (kind 'f') with abstraction edges to source chunks (keeps source_uuids). Seed rule: hybrid-search top-20 chunks with normalized RRF score as reset vector. Optional cheap phrase nodes without LLM: regex entities (file paths like src/search.ts, function/table names, URLs) + high-IDF Thai terms from term_df, weight 1/df (= HippoRAG specificity). Add only if the 86-question eval shows multi-hop gain.
mechanisms.cost: Graph-side zero LLM if facts come from the dream job; regex entities ~free. PPR itself measured locally (below).

mechanisms.name: Hebbian co-activation strengthening + global decay + dual-pathway recall
mechanisms.exact_spec: Paper Eq.1: w_ij(t+1) = (1-lambda)*w_ij(t) + eta*I(v_i,v_j in K_t), lambda=0.995, eta=0.02. CODE semantics differ: add_edge: w = min(1.0, w + eta) both directions (eta default 0.01), applied to all pairs of the retrieved set (reinforce_memory_cluster, O(K^2)); global_decay: w *= 0.995, delete if w < 0.01. Consecutive turns init edge 0.5 (code). Base score: S_base = [sim(q,e_i) + alpha*keyword_match]*exp(-dt/tau) (paper tau=60 days; code HEBBIAN_TAU=1e7 s ~116 days; keyword weight 0.5 in code). Spreading Eq.4: S(v_j) = S_base(v_j) + beta*sum_{i in N(j)} S_base(v_i)*w_ij, beta=0.1, 1 hop, only sources with score > threshold (paper 0.6, code 0.4). Dual pathway: fixed base top-k + up to max_flipped=5 extra nodes from the spreading ranking. Hub: D(v)=sum_j w_vj > delta_hub (value not specified) -> Reflective Agent distills to semantic memory. Forgetting: total edge weight < delta_prune AND inactive > delta_age AND no recent access (code defaults min_edge_weight=0.1, min_age_days=30, dry_run=True). Paper-reported LoCoMo GPT-4o-mini avg F1 34.74; w/o spreading 32.19; w/o reflective agent 29.87; w/o forgetting 34.28.
mechanisms.adopt_for_memory_hub: ADOPT with two changes. (1) Strengthen on USE, not on co-retrieval: memory_get / cited ids in the same session within 30 min appended to recall_log (one INSERT in hot path); nightly job upserts pairs: w = least(1, w_eff + 0.02), touched=now(), kind=co_use. (2) Lazy decay instead of nightly UPDATE: w_eff = w * 0.995^(days since touched) computed in the query; nightly only DELETE where w_eff < 0.01. Half-life = ln0.5/ln0.995 = 138 days, so a single co-use (0.02) disappears after ~138 days; repeated co-use accumulates. Dual pathway: keep hybrid top-k untouched, append <=5 'associated' memories with the path (via seed id + edge kind). Forgetting = prune edges only, never nodes/raw archive. Distillation of hubs = part of dream job, output fact nodes with source_uuids.
mechanisms.cost: Measured locally: 90-pair upsert 1.6 ms; full-table decay UPDATE on 160k edges 766 ms (avoided by lazy decay).

mechanisms.name: Spreading activation with fan effect, lateral inhibition, sigmoid (SYNAPSE)
mechanisms.exact_spec: Init a_i(0) = alpha*sim(h_i,h_q) for seed set T else 0. Propagate: u_i(t+1) = (1-delta)*a_i(t) + sum_{j in N(i)} S*w_ji*a_j(t)/fan(j), S=0.8, delta=0.5, fan(j)=deg_out(j); temporal edge w = exp(-rho*|tau_i - tau_j|), rho=0.01; semantic edge w = sim. Lateral inhibition: u^_i = max(0, u_i - beta*sum_{k in top-M} (u_k - u_i)*I[u_k > u_i]), beta=0.15, M=7. Sigmoid a = 1/(1+exp(-gamma*(u^ - theta))), gamma=5, theta=0.5. T=3 steps. Final S = 0.5*sim + 0.3*a(T) + 0.2*PageRank, top-k=30. Edges: temporal 1.0, abstraction 0.8, concept-concept if sim > 0.92 and in top-15; consolidation every N=5 turns; max 10,000 active nodes; dormancy eps=0.01 over 10 windows. Rejection gate tau_gate=0.12. Paper-reported LoCoMo GPT-4o-mini avg F1 40.5; w/o activation dynamics 30.5; w/o inhibition 39.4; vectors only 25.2; 1.9 s/query; code 'will be made publicly available upon acceptance'.
mechanisms.adopt_for_memory_hub: ADOPT only the fan(j) division (same as row-normalized wn) and abstraction edge weight 0.8 for fact<->chunk. SKIP lateral inhibition (ablation: only -1.1 F1, paper-reported) and sigmoid (extra knobs, no code to verify against). Temporal decay on edges exp(-0.01*dt) is not needed: memory-hub temporal edges are consecutive-chunk only.
mechanisms.cost: Iterative T=3 over the whole graph is the expensive variant; local truncated 3-iteration version = 11.9 ms p95.

mechanisms.name: Usage-modulated PPR + usage-weighted edge formula (EngramRAG)
mechanisms.from: EngramRAG arXiv 2609.32049 Eq.1-3,5-6 (preprint, Sept 2026, no code)
mechanisms.exact_spec: Edge: W_ij(t) = 0.4*cos(x_i,x_j) + 0.4*sum_{k=1..M_ij} exp(-lambda_access*(t - t_k)) + 0.2*R_type(r) (lambda_access not specified; R_SUPERSEDES=2.5); co-activation = both retrieved in the same episode. Personalization: p_i = 0.6*max(0,cos(q,i))/sum + 0.4*[log(1+n_i)*exp(-0.05*(t - t_i))]/sum, n_i = access count. pi* = (1-d)(I - d P^T)^-1 p, d=0.85, <=20 power iterations. Decay: lambda_eff(v) = lambda_base(type)*exp(-2.0*Score_topology(v)), lambda_base identity 0.0001 / preference 0.0008 / episodic 0.08. Paper-reported: LoCoMo Recall@5 53.21 vs dense 38.29 vs BM25 48.66; full retrieval 26.21 ms; U-PPR 4-6 ms at |V|=1,000 and ~50 ms at |V|=10,000.
mechanisms.adopt_for_memory_hub: ADOPT the personalization idea only if the separate usage-ranking work adds n_use/last_use per chunk: seed reset = 0.6*normalized RRF + 0.4*normalized log(1+n_use)*exp(-0.05*days_since_use). Do NOT adopt d=0.85 full-graph PPR in the hot path (their own 50 ms at 10k nodes > our 30 ms budget). CATD idea (central nodes decay slower) maps to: never decay structural edges, only co_use/dream.
mechanisms.cost: No code; numbers unverified beyond paper.

mechanisms.name: ACT-R activation: base-level + spreading with fan
mechanisms.from: ACT-R (Anderson & Lebiere 1998; Taatgen, Lebiere & Anderson chapter; Petrov 2006)
mechanisms.exact_spec: A_i = B_i + sum_j W_j*S_ji. Base level B_i = ln(sum_{j=1..n} t_j^-d), d=0.5 default (:bll .5), n = number of past uses, t_j = time since j-th use. S_ji = S - ln(fan_j), S = max associative strength (:mas, often ~2; fan model fit 1.6), W_j usually 1/n over n sources. Petrov 2006 gives a cheaper approximation keeping only the most recent use(s) exactly.
mechanisms.adopt_for_memory_hub: Use as the principled form for both asks: B_i (frequency+recency of USE) for the 'used often / old vs new' rank, and S - ln(fan) as the fan normalization in recall. Cheap SQL: store last 8 use timestamps per chunk (int[] epoch) and compute ln(sum(power(age_sec, -0.5))); Petrov approximation if arrays grow.
mechanisms.cost: Negligible; computed in SQL over at most the 20 seeds + 5 associated nodes.

mechanisms.name: memory-hub brain design (Postgres, measured locally)
mechanisms.from: Synthesis of the above; latency measured on D:\memoryhub PG 18.6 with TEMP tables (12,628 chunks, 160,104 directed edges = kNN k=8 cosine + consecutive-chunk edges, both directions)
mechanisms.exact_spec: DDL: nodes(nid serial PK, kind char(1) CHECK kind IN ('c','f','n') -- chunk|fact|obsidian note(source), ref text NOT NULL, deg int, UNIQUE(kind,ref)). synapses(src int REFERENCES nodes ON DELETE CASCADE, dst int REFERENCES nodes ON DELETE CASCADE, kind smallint -- 1 sim kNN, 2 next (same session consecutive), 3 wikilink, 4 co_use (Hebbian), 5 dream (LLM), 6 abstraction (fact<->chunk), w real CHECK (w>0 AND w<=1), wn real -- w/sum(w) per src, nightly, touched timestamptz DEFAULT now(), why text, source_uuids text[], PRIMARY KEY(src,dst,kind)); CREATE INDEX ON synapses(src) INCLUDE (dst,kind,w,wn,touched); store both directions. recall_log(ts timestamptz DEFAULT now(), session_id text, used_ids text[]). Initial weights: sim = cosine (k=8, also require cosine >= calibrated floor; HippoRAG uses 0.8 for its encoder, bge-m3 needs its own), next = 0.5 (HeLa-Mem code), wikilink = 1.0 (HippoRAG passage edge), abstraction = 0.8 (SYNAPSE), dream = 0.8*confidence, co_use += 0.02 capped 1. Kind multipliers (calibration knob, not from papers): sim 0.5, next 0.7, wikilink 1.0, co_use 1.0, dream 0.8, abstraction 0.8. Effective weight w_eff = w * CASE WHEN kind IN (4,5) THEN power(0.995, extract(epoch FROM now()-touched)/86400) ELSE 1 END. Query-time associative recall (after existing hybrid search, seeds = top-20 nids, b = RRF score): WITH s AS (SELECT unnest($1::int[]) nid, unnest($2::real[]) b) SELECT y.dst, sum(s.b*y.wn*mult*decay) a, (array_agg(s.nid ORDER BY s.b*y.wn DESC))[1] via FROM s JOIN synapses y ON y.src=s.nid WHERE y.dst <> ALL($1) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5 -> appended as 'associated' with via+kind; base top-k order untouched. Optional 2-hop: prune hop-1 frontier to top-50, hop-2 weight 0.01. Optional reranker: truncated PPR damping 0.5, 3 power iterations, frontier top-300 per iteration. MEASURED (60 random queries, parallel workers off): 1-hop p50 0.39 ms / p95 0.53 ms; 2-hop p50 0.82 / p95 1.06 ms; truncated PPR-3 p50 11.2 / p95 11.9 ms. Offline: kNN k=8 edges for all 12,628 chunks 3.2 s; row-normalize 61 ms; Hebbian 90-pair upsert 1.6 ms; full decay UPDATE 766 ms (replace with lazy decay). Nightly order: (1) kNN + next edges for new chunks, (2) wikilink edges from links (chunks of src source <-> chunks of dst source, cap 3 chunks each), (3) apply recall_log -> co_use upserts, (4) dream linker claude -p, (5) DELETE w_eff < 0.01 for kinds 4,5, (6) recompute wn and deg, ANALYZE. Obsidian view: nightly write generated md files (separate folder, not ลุงจืด's vault notes) only for fact nodes/hubs with [[links]] to neighbors with w_eff >= 0.3, so the graph view shows hundreds, not 12k, nodes.
mechanisms.adopt_for_memory_hub: ADOPT 1-hop + dual pathway first (0.5 ms, well under the 30 ms budget, adds to the 110 ms p95 search). Add truncated PPR only if the 86-question eval improves vs a plain k+5 baseline. New MCP output field 'associated' (or extend memory_related to use synapses instead of on-the-fly vector similarity).
mechanisms.cost: Storage ~160k rows per 12.6k chunks for k=8 undirected (~10-15 MB with index). Hot path: one extra indexed query (<1 ms) + one recall_log INSERT on memory_get. Nightly: seconds for graph, LLM cost only in dream step.

pitfalls: MEASURED locally: spreading activation and truncated PPR seeded by hybrid top-20 put 0.00 new memories into the top-10 (40 random queries). The seeds' own scores always win, and PPR with damping 0.5 keeps half its mass on the seeds. So graph expansion re-ranks; it does not discover. Associated memories must get their own slots (HeLa-Mem dual pathway, max_flipped=5) and must not be merged into the main ranking.

kNN-similarity edges only re-find what vector search already found, because neighbors are near-duplicates (avg edge cosine 0.78 at k=8). Associative value has to come from non-similarity synapses: consecutive-chunk temporal edges, Obsidian wikilinks (only 138 resolved links today, so sparse), co-use (Hebbian) and dream edges.

Rich-get-richer loop: HeLa-Mem strengthens every co-retrieved pair. That reinforces wrong retrievals, and retrieved items get retrieved again. Strengthen only on actual use (memory_get or a cited id), cap w at 1, and decay. HeLa-Mem's own ablation shows forgetting matters little (-0.46 F1), but that was measured on short LoCoMo dialogs, not months of usage.

Hub flooding: generic chunks (CLAUDE.md boilerplate, rules text, 'ok/continue' turns) gather many edges. Without fan normalization (HippoRAG s_i=1/|P_i|, SYNAPSE /fan(j), ACT-R S-ln(fan)) they show up as 'associated' for every query. Use the row-normalized wn and consider excluding rule/system chunks as spreading sources.

A-MEM evolution OVERWRITES neighbor notes' context/tags in place (update_neighbor). That breaks the never-auto-edit and raw-archive-is-truth constraints. Apply it only to versioned derived metadata and route rule/feedback changes to review_queue. The LLM can also return ids that are not among the candidates: drop any link whose target is outside the candidate list.

A-MEM official code gaps (verified by reading agiresearch/A-mem memory_system.py): (1) search_agentic appends linked neighbors and then returns memories[:k], so links only appear when vector search returned fewer than k hits; (2) retrieval_count and last_accessed are stored but never incremented. Do not assume A-MEM implements usage counting.

Paper vs code mismatches in HeLa-Mem. The paper writes (1-lambda)*w with lambda=0.995, which would wipe weights every step; the code does w *= 0.995. Paper eta=0.02 vs code 0.01. Paper spreading threshold 0.6 vs code 0.4. Paper tau=60 days vs code 1e7 s (about 116 days). Follow the code semantics (retention 0.995) and tune on the local eval.

igraph damping semantics: HippoRAG's damping=0.5 is the probability of following an edge, so the restart probability is also 0.5. EngramRAG uses d=0.85 in (1-d)(I-dP^T)^-1 p. Mixing up the two conventions silently changes how far activation travels.

Latency scaling: EngramRAG itself reports full U-PPR at about 50 ms for 10k nodes (paper-reported), which breaks a 30 ms budget. Keep PPR truncated to a small subgraph (measured 11.9 ms p95 for 3 iterations x top-300 frontier), or use 1-hop (0.53 ms p95).

Nightly full-table decay UPDATE (766 ms for 160k rows) creates dead tuples and bloat every night. Lazy decay (store touched, compute w*0.995^days at read time, nightly DELETE below 0.01) avoids rewriting the table.

Eval trap: 'top-10 + 5 associated' must be compared against a plain hybrid top-15. Otherwise any recall gain is just the larger k. Report R@10 unchanged plus R@15 vs baseline R@15 on the 86 questions.

Every benchmark number above is paper-reported on English, mostly synthetic dialog sets (LoCoMo, MuSiQue, 2Wiki, HotpotQA) with other LLMs and embedders. None of them transfers to Thai, English and source-code chat logs. Only the local latency numbers were measured here, on 12,628 chunks.

HippoRAG-style OpenIE/NER is English-centric and LLM-heavy at indexing time. For Thai, node keys must not depend on word segmentation variants: use chunk ids as nodes, and use regex entities for code (file paths, identifiers, table names) instead of LLM extraction. Any LLM entity extraction belongs in the nightly claude -p job, never at query time.

Never let forgetting delete nodes or raw chunks. HeLa-Mem's adaptive forgetting removes nodes, which conflicts with 'raw archive stays the source of truth'. Prune edges only; low-activation memories should rank lower, not disappear.
